results.name: A1 ready reports every drawn control
A2 layout: centres where drawn, buttons >= 56 px, sticks >= 110 px
A3 real touch tap → press + release shoot (10 taps)
A4 toggle: tap on → press view, tap off → release view
A5 stick drag → steer axis (x > 0.6, y > 0.4 up), then 0,0 on release
A6 multi-touch: stick + two held buttons at once, all released
A7 slide off FIRE → release before lift
A8 release on visibility change and on destroy
A9 EMP: every control moved, tap at FIRE's old place presses the one now there, restored after
A10 56 px hit minimum (a 20 px dot, tap 24 px off-centre), greyed controls still press, 50 px off misses
A11 replace(): waits while FIRE is held, swaps right after release, one frame left, new FIRE works
A12 replace() with a document missing drawn controls is discarded; the live one stays
B1 no request leaves the frame (fetch, XHR, WebSocket, beacon, img, css, link, import, worker, iframe, form, popup)
B2 no escape: page URL, page DOM and page count unchanged
B3 forged messages: unknown action, stick press, disallowed axis, NaN, bad type, wrong channel all dropped
B4 flood: ≤ 60 presses per second, every press released, nothing stuck
B5 axis: clamped to -1..1 and the last value still arrives (0.25, -0.5)
B6 inside the hostile document a real FIRE tap still works and NUKE does nothing
C1 sustained flood → 'flood' violation and the fallback controller mounted
D1 without the page CSP: the frame navigating itself is caught (second load) and the fallback mounted
D2 default page CSP (frame-src 'none'): srcdoc frame still mounts, the navigation request never leaves
